situation_paragraph_1: Your husband's transfer to Houston starts in January, and you want the family settled there before the kids begin the spring semester. That puts the real deadline at being under contract by early December, so the plan below is built around that date, not around squeezing out the last dollar.
situation_paragraph_2: You've taken good care of the house. The 2023 roof and the kitchen you redid two years ago are the two things Copper Mill buyers ask about first. The back fence and the original master bath are known, and we'll present them honestly rather than let a buyer discover them.
client_quote: Honestly we just want this part over so we can focus on the move.
motivation: Job transfer to Houston starting in January. You want to be under contract by early December.
timeline: Photos next Tuesday, live on the MLS Thursday, October 23, first open house Saturday, October 25. Under contract by early December.
property_facts: Bought in 2019. New roof in 2023. Kitchen remodeled two years ago. Back fence needs work. Master bath is original.
concerns: Keeping strangers out of the house while the kids are home, and pricing wrong and carrying two homes. Showings run through ShowingTime so you approve each one and we set windows.
pricing_strategy: Price at $349,900 to pull the first-weekend crowd, hold the open house that Saturday, and let buyers push the number. With a December deadline the first ten days matter more than an extra ten thousand on the list price. We can always counter up.
pricing_basis: Turnberry closed at $352,000 in August, two streets over at $341,000 in July, Copper Mill Boulevard at $368,000 with an extra bedroom. Your kitchen is nicer than two of the three.
marketing_notes: Showing windows set around the kids' schedule, every showing approved by you in ShowingTime.
listing_term: Six months, with the plan to be done well before that
commission: 2.5% on my side. Buyer agent compensation discussed when offers come in.
next_step: Accept this page, I send the listing agreement through Authentisign, and the photographer comes out next Tuesday.
